what_happened: The job to give OLY-B-SET-02 a model-roster mechanism and test was rejected at the final verdict. The verifier gave one major finding and no blockers. No acceptance criteria or checks are listed as failed. The finding: the roster (ROSTER in crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs) is a hard-coded list that no code reads. Its test (crates/athena-core/tests/model_roster.rs) only checks that constants exist. Neither shows that work uses Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
cause: The accepted criteria for a "mechanism" were satisfied by the presence of a data structure and a test of its constants. Nothing required the mechanism to be wired into the code that picks models for agents, or the test to show that a real run reads it. A list nothing consumes passes presence-style criteria. Only the verifier's independent reading showed that it changes no behavior. The same family of OLY mechanism jobs keeps hitting this gap.
other_causes: The reading likely did not name the consumer of the roster, such as the config or dispatch path that selects a model per role, so the producer had no target to wire it to.
Nothing before the final verdict checks that a newly added constant or list has a reader in non-test code.
open_hypotheses: The fields do not show whether the request or the accepted reading named where the roster should be consumed, so we cannot tell whether the reading or the producer dropped the wiring.
The fields do not show whether an existing model-selection path in the config could have been reused.
contradictions: The earlier cases in this family were mostly status-measure jobs rejected for a proxy predicate (a2bc), not for an unused constant. This event is a roster with no reader, so the match to the presence-not-behavior class is by shape rather than by identical history.
prevention: Require every criterion for a new mechanism to name its consumer. The criterion would say which non-test code reads the new data and what observable behavior changes. Its demonstration would run that code path, for example resolving the model for each role from the roster, and would fail if the roster were removed or changed. A check on the diff should flag new public constants or lists that have no non-test reader before the verifier runs. A criterion that only proves a constant exists should be refused as presence-only.
proposed_request: Give OLY-B-SET-02 a working model-roster mechanism. The roster of Opus, Sonnet and Haiku in crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs must be read by the code that chooses the model for each agent role, so that changing the roster changes which model a role runs on. Remove any hard-coded duplicate model choice that bypasses it. Add a test that resolves the model for each role through the real selection path. It must show that each of the three models is used by at least one role, and that editing the roster entry changes the resolved model. The test must fail if nothing reads the roster. Add the CHANGELOG.md entry. Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test before finishing.
